episodes.title: Camp Cretaceous
episodes.summary: After waiting his whole life to see dinosaurs, lucky Darius wins the chance to join five other campers on Isla Nublar for a once-in-a-lifetime adventure.

episodes.title: Secrets
episodes.summary: With the rest of the crew off visiting a genetics lab, Kenji sneaks Darius into the park's top-secret underbelly — and straight into danger.

episodes.title: The Cattle Drive
episodes.summary: The campers hop into their Gyrospheres to help move a dinosaur herd toward fresh grazing lands. But an incoming storm stirs up unexpected trouble.

episodes.title: Things Fall Apart
episodes.summary: Darius remembers the promise he made to his dad. Elsewhere on the island, the campers find themselves face-to-face with a newly freed threat.

episodes.title: Happy Birthday, Eddie!
episodes.summary: After a close encounter with the Indominus, the gang seeks shelter in the genetics lab, where a strange scientist reveals the truth about Dr. Wu.

episodes.title: Welcome to Jurassic World
episodes.summary: Sammy's secret shocks everyone — but there's no time for anger when an accident unleashes a flock of Pteranodons and forces the crew below ground.

episodes.title: Last Day of Camp
episodes.summary: The campers leave the Mosasaurus lagoon and fight their way onto the monorail … where Ben gets a chance to face his fears.

episodes.title: End of the Line
episodes.summary: It's a race against time as the campers make their way to the main dock to catch the last ferry leaving the island. But what if they're too late?

episodes.title: A Beacon of Hope
episodes.summary: Still stranded on the island — and still reeling from the apparent loss of Ben — the campers make a last-ditch attempt at rescue by sending out an SOS.

episodes.title: The Art of Chill
episodes.summary: Darius and Sammy face a moral dilemma while searching the park for supplies. The campers start building a new treehouse. Brooklynn sees something odd.

episodes.title: The Watering Hole
episodes.summary: Brooklynn, Sammy and Yasmina team up to investigate strange noises in the park. Elsewhere, Darius and Kenji go exploring and witness a majestic sight.

episodes.title: Salvation
episodes.summary: A bonfire in the distance signals that the campers have company: a pair of posh eco-tourists and their disgruntled security guy. But can they be trusted?

episodes.title: Brave
episodes.summary: The campers reunite with a long-lost friend, who shares an inspiring story — then reveals that Mitch, Tiff and Hap aren't who they seem.

episodes.title: Misguided
episodes.summary: Darius must make a difficult choice to save Sammy and Yasmina. Meanwhile, the remaining campers are trying to decide if Hap is a friend... or a foe.

episodes.title: Step One
episodes.summary: Brooklynn, Ben, Kenji and Yasmina work to uncover a secret and restore power to the park as Darius leads Mitch and Tiff straight into a T. rex trap.

episodes.title: Chaos Theory
episodes.summary: A guilty Darius is determined to protect the island's innocent dinos — even if he has to do it all alone. But with luck, maybe he won't have to...

episodes.title: View from the Top
episodes.summary: The campers catch a lift to Lookout Point in search of materials to make a sail, then must quickly find a way back down. Ben worries about leaving Bumpy

episodes.title: Safe Harbor
episodes.summary: After finding Mitch and Tiff`s abandoned yacht, the happy campers celebrate. But the party`s over when something big goes in the night

episodes.title: Casa De Kenji
episodes.summary: Kenji takes the campers to his father`s penthouse to gather supplies - but they`ve soon got company. Sammy reflects on what life must be like back home.

episodes.title: Clever Girl
episodes.summary: A thrilling chase brings Darius, Kenji and Yaz to the old Jurassic Park Visitors Center. Elsewhere on the island, Brooklynn and Sammy find a secret lab.

episodes.title: Eye of the Storm
episodes.summary: Sammy and Brooklynn rush to warn the others about a sinister new threat while Darius, unware of the danger, searches for his dad`s favorite dinosaur.

episodes.title: The Long Run
episodes.summary: As a poisoned camper fights to survive, it`s up to Yaz - the fastest among them - to fetch the antidote before it`s too late.

episodes.title: A Shock to the System
episodes.summary: It`s crunch time for the campers to get to the boat and make their escape... until Ben disappears, deciding he`d rather stay. Can Darius change his mind?

episodes.title: Escape from Isla Nublar
episodes.summary: With multiple threats running rampant on the island, dinosaur lover Darius must put his feelings aside and make a difficult decision.

episodes.title: Whatever It Takes
episodes.summary: The group is forced to switch gears when a familiar face returns to Isla Nublar. Now, getting off the island is no longer the most important thing.

episodes.title: Stay on Mission
episodes.summary: With Brooklynn being held prisoner, the remaining campers hatch a plan to rescue her - and it won't be easy

episodes.title: Beneath the Surface
episodes.summary: Out at sea, the campers see sunny skies... then discover a stowaway on board. A surprise attack from the deep leaves them stranded on unfamiliar shores.

episodes.title: At Least...
episodes.summary: The weary crew dodges danger in the desert while trying to figure out where they are. But they unearth more questions than answers.

episodes.title: Turning Dr. Turner
episodes.summary: A strange tunnel takes the teens to a lush forest, where they meet a mysterious scientist studying dino behavior. The question is: Can they trust her?

episodes.title: Rude Awakening
episodes.summary: With Dr. Turner's help, the campers hatch a plan to get off the island that finds them crossing a snowy arctic biome — and making a selfless rescue.

episodes.title: The Long Game
episodes.summary: After learning the truth about Mae's boss, Sammy's ready to go rogue to take him down... just as Mae gets ready to confront him. Cue the killer robots!

episodes.title: Mission Critical
episodes.summary: With Mae in serious condition and Kash's end game clear, the campers vow to save the dinosaurs and stop Mantah Corp. But evil BRADs are everywhere.

episodes.title: Staying Alive
episodes.summary: Darius has to think fast to distract Kash and protect the others, so he pretends to hate dinos as much as Kash does — while learning everything he can.

episodes.title: Technical Difficulties
episodes.summary: Brooklynn must devise a hack to help Darius, who's being tailed by an upgraded BRAD-X. Meanwhile, Kash prepares to woo a group of dangerous investors.

episodes.title: Dino-Sitting
episodes.summary: Darius keeps Kash busy with competitive video gaming while the others break into the nursery. Yaz asks Brooklynn how she feels about Kenji.

episodes.title: Taking Control
episodes.summary: Ben's refusal to bond with a new friend leads to regret — and a realization that it's time to take Kash down. Kenji and Brooklynn face their feelings.

episodes.title: Who's the Boss?
episodes.summary: Just when it feels like things are getting back to normal, Kash's boss arrives on Mantah Corp. island and begins moving forward with a devastating plan.

episodes.title: Reunited
episodes.summary: Kenji's thrilled to see his father - and eager to prove himself. Elsewhere, Sammy and Brooklynn team up to find out what happened to Sammy's family.

episodes.title: The Final Test
episodes.summary: A cryptic clue prompts Brooklynn, Darius and Ben to dig into Mr. Kon's motives. Kenji plans a date with Brooklynn while helping his dad prep for a party.

episodes.title: Battle Lines
episodes.summary: Kenji asks his friends to back off and stay out of his father's business. But to save the island's dinos, they're willing to risk breaking his trust.

episodes.title: Evasive Action
episodes.summary: A stunning betrayal lands the friends in lockdown, where they unpack their feelings and plot their escape. Kenji follows his father to Isla Nublar.

episodes.title: Shaky Ground
episodes.summary: Something unsettling is sending the dinos into a frenzy. Darius and Brooklynn pour their energies into problem-solving. Kenji chooses sides.

episodes.title: Out of the Pack
episodes.summary: Kenji accepts an important assignment - and drives straight into danger. Back on Mantah Corp. Island, the others race to ruin Mr, Kon's plans.

episodes.title: The Leap
episodes.summary: The Kids come up with a plan to protect the dinosaurs. Left on her own, Sammy will have to rely on her own strength. Yaz opens up to Ben.

episodes.title: Clean Break
episodes.summary: An Increasingly suspicious Kenji starts looking into his father's activities. Mae works to break free from Kon's control and follow her heart.

episodes.title: The Core
episodes.summary: Yaz is ready to tell Sammy the truth - but the island has other plans. A conflicted Darius worries that he's lost his way.

episodes.title: Arrival
episodes.summary: The friends must think fast to outwit Mr. Kon and his cronies. Ben sets out to rescue an old friend - and gets help from a surprising source.

episodes.title: The Last Stand
episodes.summary: A high-stakes battle begins for control of Mantah Corp. Island. Kenji's ready to rejoin his friends, but Darius isn't sure he can forgive him.

episodes.title: The Nublar Six
episodes.summary: With the future of the Island at steak, the friends band together - and fight harder than ever before - to protect what's really important.
